# omniddi_dns_views (Data Source)

Lists DNS views, optionally narrowed by server-side filters. Every filter must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_dns_views" "all" {}

data "omniddi_dns_views" "high_priority" {
  filters = [
    { field = "priority", operator = "LTE", value = "50" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Filters sent to the OmniDDI `viewsPaginated` query. Field names are the camelCase or snake_case view fields, for example `name` or `priority`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `views` (Attributes List) The matching views, ordered by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--views))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `field` (String) View field to filter on.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator: `EQ`, `NEQ`, `IN`, `NIN`, `CONTAINS`, `NOT_CONTAINS`, `STARTS_WITH`, `ENDS_WITH`, `GT`, `GTE`, `LT`, `LTE`, `IS_NULL`, `NOT_NULL`.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Comparison value. Not used with `IN`, `NIN`, `IS_NULL` and `NOT_NULL`.
- `values` (List of String) Comparison values for `IN` and `NIN`.


<a id="nestedatt--views"></a>
### Nested Schema for `views`

Read-Only:

- `allow_query_acl_id` (Number) Id of the allow-query ACL.
- `allow_recursion_acl_id` (Number) Id of the allow-recursion ACL.
- `allow_update_acl_id` (Number) Id of the allow-update ACL.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) View description.
- `forward_only` (Boolean) Whether the view only uses its forwarders.
- `forwarders` (Attributes List) View forwarders; null when the view inherits the server forwarders. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--views--forwarders))
- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI view id.
- `match_destinations_acl_id` (Number) Id of the match-destinations ACL.
- `match_recursive_only` (Boolean) Whether only recursive queries select the view.
- `max_cache_ttl` (Number) `max-cache-ttl` in seconds.
- `max_ncache_ttl` (Number) `max-ncache-ttl` in seconds.
- `name` (String) View name.
- `priority` (Number) Match priority; a lower number is matched first.
- `recursion` (Boolean) Per-view recursion setting; null when the view inherits the server setting.
- `server_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the server groups that publish the view.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued tags on the view. Not populated by the plural data source.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued tags on the view. Not populated by the plural data source.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `view_acl_id` (Number) Id of the ACL that selects clients for the view.
- `zone_count` (Number) Number of zones in the view.

<a id="nestedatt--views--forwarders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `views.forwarders`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Forwarder address.
- `port` (Number) Forwarder port.
